rationale: Analysis must honor a validated profile
Capabilities are derived from analysis evidence
Gaps depend on what capabilities/facts exist
Recipes define required/optional facts evaluated as gaps
Minimum view contract is a baseline recipe set
Business sheets use human context when available
Publication settings choose output from recipe/projection
Fidelity report is attached to render/publication request
Agent can propose specs through MCP
Evolution delta needs immutable comparable snapshot identities
Environment declarations generated in analysis, not every Project node
Release must map to deployable instance
Actual drift needs evidenced deployment instances
Preset needs detected capabilities, not exclusive archetype
Availability based on contextual gap reasoning
ZOO exercises scanner and expected baseline
Asset requirements result from selected recipes
Vault stores selected/approved assets, no semantic truth
Nested repo metadata remains separate from traversal
Host event must be eligible for receipt/evidence review
